standard: T-1727. The committed alternates of single structures, selected by ?structure=<id>&version=<label>. Fetched by the renderer only when the address asks for a version — never at boot — and each row swaps exactly one building of this scene for its alternate record and mesh. version=default names the canonical record.

glessner_house.label: pre-v4
glessner_house.summary: The default build of John J. Glessner House until version “v4” was promoted on 2026-09-30. Kept so the two can still be compared side by side.

glessner_house.label: v2
glessner_house.summary: An independent build: the east wing's ridge read 4 ft toward the courtyard (from the chimneys and the 1965 north plate), a larger north tower, 18th Street and stable heights from the HABS photogrammetric plates, the house on the alley line, and a smoke-weathered palette.

glessner_house.label: v3
glessner_house.summary: Independent reading of the same T-1731/HABS-photo/Houghton sources: granite read toward the museum's 'pink' name rather than Glessner's grey; the stable roof kept symmetric on the wing's centreline; the tower, turret, chimney depths, dormers, hall-bow roof, courtyard windows and courtyard ground each independently reconstructed. L301.
